description: This file defines inline functions for various Fourier transform operations in the torch::fft namespace, including fft, ifft, fft2, ifft2, fftn, irfft, rfft, rfft2, irfft2, rfftn, irfftn, hfft, ihfft, hfft2, ihfft2, hfftn, ihfftn, fftfreq, rfftfreq, fftshift, and ifftshift. It serves as an interface for FFT-related functionalities in the PyTorch C++ API.

methods.name: fft
methods.description: Performs a 1D FFT on a tensor, with optional size, dimension, and normalization parameters.

methods.name: ifft
methods.description: Performs a 1D inverse FFT on a tensor, with optional size, dimension, and normalization parameters.

methods.name: fft2
methods.description: Performs a 2D FFT on a tensor, with optional size, dimensions, and normalization parameters.

methods.name: ifft2
methods.description: Performs a 2D inverse FFT on a tensor, with optional size, dimensions, and normalization parameters.

methods.name: fftn
methods.description: Performs an N-dimensional FFT on a tensor, with optional size, dimensions, and normalization parameters.

methods.name: ifftn
methods.description: Performs an N-dimensional inverse FFT on a tensor, with optional size, dimensions, and normalization parameters.

methods.name: rfft
methods.description: Computes the 1D real-input FFT with onesided Hermitian output.

methods.name: irfft
methods.description: Computes the inverse of rfft, returning real-valued output from a Hermitian Fourier domain input.

methods.name: rfft2
methods.description: Computes the 2D real-input FFT with onesided Hermitian output.

methods.name: irfft2
methods.description: Computes the inverse of rfft2, returning Hermitian symmetric output.

methods.name: rfftn
methods.description: Computes the N-dimensional real-input FFT with onesided Hermitian output.

methods.name: irfftn
methods.description: Computes the inverse of rfftn, returning Hermitian symmetric output.

methods.name: hfft
methods.description: Computes the 1D FFT of a Hermitian symmetric input signal.

methods.name: ihfft
methods.description: Computes the inverse FFT of a real-valued Fourier domain signal, producing a Hermitian symmetric time domain signal.

methods.name: hfft2
methods.description: Computes the 2D FFT of a Hermitian symmetric input signal.

methods.name: ihfft2
methods.description: Computes the 2D inverse FFT of a real input signal.

methods.name: hfftn
methods.description: Computes the N-dimensional FFT of a Hermitian symmetric input signal.

methods.name: ihfftn
methods.description: Computes the N-dimensional inverse FFT of a real input signal.

methods.name: fftfreq
methods.description: Computes the discrete Fourier Transform sample frequencies for a signal of size n.

methods.name: rfftfreq
methods.description: Computes the sample frequencies for torch.fft.rfft with a signal of size n.

methods.name: fftshift
methods.description: Reorders n-dimensional FFT output to have negative frequency terms first.

methods.name: ifftshift
methods.description: Inverse of fftshift, restoring original frequency order.
